beforeReadFile.command: for d in "$CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT"; do g="$d/hooks/env_guard.py"; if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$g" ]; then p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || break; exec "$p" "$g" --client cursor; fi; done; echo '{"permission":"allow"}'

beforeShellExecution.command: for d in "$CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT"; do g="$d/hooks/env_guard.py"; if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$g" ]; then p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || break; exec "$p" "$g" --client cursor; fi; done; echo '{"permission":"allow"}'
